description: This file defines Express route handlers for managing digital health certificates, including issuing certificates, retrieving certificate lists, and downloading certificates as PDFs with embedded QR codes.

methods.name: POST /issue
methods.description: Issues a new health certificate for an approved application, creating a PDF with QR code and updating application status.

methods.name: GET /
methods.description: Retrieves all certificates, with filtering based on user role—admins and doctors see all, patients see only their own.

methods.name: GET /:id/download
methods.description: Allows authorized users to download a specific certificate as a PDF, which includes a QR code for verification.
